tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — warm biscuit cream. Default app ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, chat bubbles from the owner, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Chat thread background, input wells, skeletons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and sticker outlines on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-tint. Also the sticker border.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (timestamps, hints, meta) on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Text-field and unselected-chip borders (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Tangerine — the Snoutly colour. Primary buttons, active nav pill, the logo. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Links and brand-coloured text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft tangerine fill: selected chips, dog avatars, highlights. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand, sunny, mint, sky, bubblegum fills.

tokens.name: bubblegum
tokens.usage: Playful accent: favourites, celebratory moments, the vet's typing dots.

tokens.name: bubblegum-tint
tokens.usage: Cat avatars, vet chat bubbles. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Fresh accent: 'online now' dots, completed paw steps.

tokens.name: mint-tint
tokens.usage: Rabbit avatars, success-adjacent soft panels. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Calm accent: video-call surfaces, info illustrations.

tokens.name: sky-tint
tokens.usage: Bird avatars, info panels. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: sunny
tokens.usage: Rating stars, rewards, the 'treat' moments.

tokens.name: sunny-tint
tokens.usage: 'Other' pet avatars, gentle notices. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: Deep plum: hero panels, the active nav item background in light, premium badges. Text on it is on-berry.

tokens.name: on-berry
tokens.usage: Text and icons on berry.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Teal (kept off the red–green axis): 'Consult complete', saved, paid. Always with an icon or word. Text on surface and success-tint.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Success banner and badge fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting-room and 'vet running late' text on surface and warning-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning banner and badge fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Urgent / emergency text and outlines on surface and danger-tint. Always paired with the alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Urgent banner and badge fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen: onboarding and celebration screens.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the top bar, sheet titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, vet names, section headers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Tell us what's going on with your pet.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy and list rows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, badges, nav labels. Never below 12px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; between stacked chat bubbles from the same sender.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button icon gap; inner padding of compact cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on mobile; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of screen to hero headline; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Big breathing room around empty states and celebrations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small tags, input inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, chat bubbles, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the bottom nav.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels and onboarding illustrations.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the active nav pill.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: The Snoutly 'sticker' lift under buttons and interactive cards; pair with the 2px ink border.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state: element moves down 3px and the shadow shrinks — a squish.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom nav, sheets and toasts floating above content.

tokens.name: stroke-sticker
tokens.usage: Ink outline on buttons, cards, avatars and the bottom nav.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width (offset 2px).

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar height (plus safe-area inset).

tokens.name: screen-min
tokens.usage: Design baseline width; everything must work here first.
